meta.claims_policy: No ratings, sold counts, discounts, or review claims are recorded anywhere — none were verifiable. pros/cons/key_features use only listing-title and listing-spec facts, attributed with '(per listing title)' / '(per listing specs)'.

meta.image_url: PENDING-MERCHANT-IMAGE for every product — the original merchant CDN image (ae01.alicdn.com or equivalent) must be captured from each live AliExpress listing by the parent / live browser. No image was guessed or substituted, per the original-merchant-images-only rule.
meta.price_note: Prices below were last observed by the imall.com index on the crawl dates shown (May–Jul 2026). They are NOT verified live AliExpress prices today. Re-verify every price on the live listing before publishing or importing. meta.verification_method: Each item verified as a real aliexpress.com listing through the imall.com third-party product index: exact listing title + numeric AliExpress SKU + aliexpress.com source + no 'not available' flag on the index crawl date. Items flagged unavailable by the index were rejected.
